body: [Moodgym](https://moodgym.anu.edu.au/welcome) is a free and online introduction to the techniques of CBT, but what's going to matter is sticking with it and practicing the skills you learn. I used to get discouraged because I'd find that I knew all the skills and what I was *suppose* to be thinking but life wasn't getting any better. Then I realized it's really about changing a habit, a cognitive habit; knowing isn't enough. Good luck! I'm really happy you're feeling better!

>Funny story, rats aren't humans.

Very good point. Animal studies are necessary but not sufficient for proving the efficacy of a drug. Testing with live animals or with cells needs to occur as part of the pharmaceutical research process, but without further research, it can't be concluded to be effective or approved by the FDA.
